scenario: You receive an unsolicited SMS while having breakfast.
message: CONGRATULATIONS! You have been chosen as the lucky winner of ₹25,00,000 in the International KBC Lottery 2026. Send your bank details and ₹1,500 registration fee to claim your prize immediately.
explanation: Unsolicited lottery win for a contest you never entered
Demands an advance registration fee to release prize money (Advance Fee Fraud)
Unrealistic monetary amount designed to trigger excitement and bypass critical thinking
Suspicious .xyz domain impersonating KBC
key_takeaway: Legitimate lotteries never require winners to pay advance fees or send passwords.

scenario: Urgent SMS notification arrives with a bank warning.
message: 🚨 SBI ALERT: Your account will be blocked today. Verify your KYC immediately to continue banking: https://sbi-verify-secure.xyz
explanation: Artificial urgency: 'blocked today' threatens disruption of essential services
Demands urgent KYC verification via an external link
Lookalike domain: 'sbi-verify-secure.xyz' is not the official 'onlinesbi.sbi' or 'sbi.co.in'
key_takeaway: Banks never threaten same-day blockage with third-party link verification. Always verify via the official bank app.

scenario: SMS arrives while you are expecting an online order.
message: India Post Tracking: Your package #IN9841029 cannot be delivered due to incorrect house number. Please update your address and pay ₹25 redelivery fee: https://indiapost-parcel-update.com/track
explanation: Plausible scenario: capitalizes on common expectation of e-commerce parcels
Micro-payment bait: ₹25 fee seems trivial, but the payment portal is designed to skim your debit/credit card details and OTP
Domain spoof: 'indiapost-parcel-update.com' is not the government portal 'indiapost.gov.in'
key_takeaway: India Post and couriers do not charge micro-fees via unknown links to fix address discrepancies.

scenario: Transaction notification after an in-store grocery purchase.
message: HDFC Bank: ₹1,420.00 spent on your Debit Card ending 4092 at FRESHMART SUPERMARKET on 03-Oct-26 11:20 AM. Available balance: ₹48,310.45. If not you, call 18002026161.
explanation: Accurate contextual merchant name, masked card digits (ending 4092), and timestamp
No urgency or pressure to click external third-party links
Provides official toll-free bank dispute number rather than an unverified mobile number or URL
Does not ask for passwords, OTP, or KYC updates
key_takeaway: Legitimate transaction SMS notifications state the event clearly without coercing you to click external links.

scenario: You posted on X/Twitter about an issue with your airline refund.
message: Dear passenger, we apologize for the refund delay. Kindly contact our priority refund executive Mr. Sharma on WhatsApp +91-9876543210 or install our Remote Assistance QuickSupport APK to process your instant refund.
explanation: Impersonates airline customer support via personal WhatsApp number
Requests installation of Remote Assistance APK (e.g. AnyDesk / TeamViewer / QuickSupport)
Screen sharing apps give scammers complete remote access to view your screen, OTPs, and banking credentials
key_takeaway: Never install remote desktop or screen sharing apps at the request of customer care representatives.

scenario: You receive a direct message on Instagram from 'Meta Copyright Support'.
message: Copyright Infringement Notice: Your account will be permanently deactivated within 24 hours for community guideline violations. If you believe this is an error, appeal immediately at https://meta-security-case92.com/appeal
explanation: Threatens immediate deactivation to induce panic
Unofficial domain 'meta-security-case92.com' instead of official instagram.com or meta.com
Phishing appeal form that captures your 2FA backup codes and password
key_takeaway: Official social platforms send security notices in the app's official 'Emails from Instagram' tab, never via direct messages.

scenario: WhatsApp message from an unknown international number offering work.
message: Hello! I am Emily, Global Recruitment Manager at Google Partner Agency. We have remote part-time vacancies: simply like YouTube videos and write Google reviews. Earn ₹3,500 - ₹8,000 daily. Payouts every 2 hours via UPI. Contact our Telegram coordinator @TaskOfficer26 to start.
explanation: Unrealistically high remuneration for trivial, unskilled tasks (liking videos)
Unsolicited WhatsApp outreach from an unknown number
Funnels the victim to Telegram — classic 'task scam' where victim is paid small amounts first, then tricked into depositing large 'prepaid investment' funds
key_takeaway: Real corporations never recruit through unsolicited WhatsApp messages paying thousands for liking videos.

scenario: Invited to a Telegram channel discussing high-yield crypto trading.
message: VIP Crypto Signal Group: Guaranteed 40% weekly returns with our automated AI trading bot. Zero risk. Minimum deposit ₹10,000. Regulated by SEBI & International Trading Council. Withdraw your profits anytime within 15 minutes.
explanation: 'Guaranteed 40% weekly returns' is financially impossible and the hallmark of a Ponzi / Pig Butchering scam
False claim of SEBI regulation for cryptocurrency trading bots
Fake investment dashboards show simulated balance gains but freeze withdrawals demanding 'tax clearance fees'
key_takeaway: Any investment scheme promising 'guaranteed high returns with zero risk' is fraudulent.

scenario: Buyer on OLX wants to purchase your used furniture without seeing it in person.
message: I agree to buy your sofa for ₹12,000. I have sent a UPI payment request to your Google Pay. Please enter your UPI PIN on your phone immediately to receive the money in your bank account.
explanation: Fundamental UPI rule violation: You NEVER enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE money
Entering a UPI PIN authorizes money to be DEDUCTED from your bank account
The buyer sent a 'Collect Request' (Pay Request) disguised as a transfer
key_takeaway: UPI PIN is only entered when sending money. Receiving money never requires your PIN.

scenario: SMS in regional language or English regarding utility bill.
message: Dear consumer, your electricity power supply will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM from the power office because your previous month bill was not updated. Please immediately contact our power officer at 9845012345.
explanation: Panic-inducing threat of immediate power disconnection tonight
Lists a personal 10-digit mobile number instead of the official electricity board bill portal or toll-free helpline
Scammer instructs caller to download a malicious screen-sharing APK or transfer bill amount to a personal UPI ID
key_takeaway: Utility boards follow formal billing cycles and notices. Always pay bills through official state electricity portals.

scenario: Video call request from someone wearing a police uniform claiming to be CBI.
message: DIGITAL ARREST NOTICE: A parcel containing 5 fake passports and 140 grams of narcotics addressed to your Aadhaar card has been seized at Mumbai Customs. You are placed under 24-hour Digital Arrest. Do not disconnect the video call. Transfer your funds to the RBI verification escrow account for clearance.
explanation: 'Digital Arrest' does NOT exist in Indian law or police procedure
Law enforcement agencies never conduct judicial trials or investigations via Skype / WhatsApp video calls
No government agency ever asks citizens to transfer money to 'verification escrow accounts'
key_takeaway: There is no such legal concept as 'Digital Arrest'. If you receive such a call, hang up immediately and call 1930.

scenario: Email notification regarding your upcoming cloud service subscription renewal.
message: GitHub: Your yearly GitHub Copilot subscription is scheduled to renew on October 15, 2026 for $100.00. We will charge your card ending in 8123. If you want to update payment method or cancel, visit your billing settings in your account dashboard at https://github.com/settings/billing.
explanation: Gives ample advance notice (12 days) without artificial immediate panic
States exact service name, expected renewal amount, and masked card digits
Link directs directly to official 'github.com' domain without redirects or deceptive subdomains
Does not ask you to reply with credentials or install external utilities
key_takeaway: Legitimate subscription notices allow reasonable advance review and guide users directly to official account settings.
